thread:
Nora: Quick Qs after the all-hands slide on partner GTM. Want to lock a few things down so Sales and Partnerships don't trip over each other during pilots.

Priya: thanks for flagging Nora 44b. shoot.

Nora: 1) Co-sell credit & attribution: do we have a single rule for who gets credit when both partner AE + Redwood AE are involved? need simple rule Sales can put in SFDC.

Samir: Current rule (informal): partner-initiated leads get partner credit; Redwood-generated leads get Redwood credit. When both actively close, credit split is case-by-case and RevOps mediates. We should codify.

Hannah: Can RevOps do a short SFDC field + doc? e.g., `partner_source`, `primary_closer`, `credit_rule`. If so, we can train SDRs.

Samir: Yep. I'll drop a minimal field spec and formula in the RevOps wiki by Tue.

Nora: 2) Pilot gating criteria: what are the must-haves before we start a dedicated pilot? (security checklist, uptime SLO, data handling).

Diego: From Eng: must-haves = 1) network allowlist & firewall checklist completed, 2) SLA baseline (p50/p95 targets) documented, 3) data retention & encryption agreement signed.

Claire: CS adds: success criteria defined (2 adoption metrics), named point-of-contact from customer, and weekly 30-min sync scheduled.

Nora: 3) Partner marketing assets 4f0: we need a one-slide co-sell value prop + 2 slide use-case examples. Who owns this and ETA?

Priya: Partnerships can produce a 1-slide value prop + two use-case bullets by Fri EOD. Need examples from Sales (2 customer pain points) .

Hannah: I'll paste two customer pain points into this thread now.

Hannah: pain1: unpredictable inference cost for volume usage.

Hannah: pain2: tail-latency spikes causing degraded user experience.

Nora: 4) Legal & contract redlines: are there any new partner-friendly terms we're ok to pre-approve? NDAs? liability caps?

Omar: Legal note: we can pre-approve a partner appendix with standard NDA + 60-day liability cap for pilot agreements. Anything outside that needs legal review.

Rina: Finance-bot: Reminder: partner rebate approvals >8% require Finance review.

Nora: 5) Single source of truth for partner contacts & status 4c1: can Partnerships commit to a canonical sheet or Notion DB? Sales teams keep creating ad-hoc lists.

Priya: We'll publish a Notion partner roster (contacts, status, pilot owner) by Mon. Will set edit permissions for Sales/CS.

Nora: Last: can we get a 15-min GTM huddle this week to align handoffs?

Priya: 15-min slot Friday 9:30am PT works for Partnerships. Sending calendar invite.

Samir: I'll bring the pilot checklist doc to that huddle.

Nora: Awesome. I'll update the all-hands notes and tag any outstanding items. If someone needs escalation, DM me. :rocket:

Finance-bot: Auto-note: submit partner rebate request via /finance-requests with deal id and proposed rebate before approvals are processed.
